key_insight: Increasing the number of blades on vertical-axis wind turbines significantly influences near-wake dynamics and the dynamic stall process.
engineering_relevance: Understanding these interactions is crucial for optimizing turbine performance in closely-spaced turbine arrays.
method: Geometrically-resolved Direct Numerical Simulations performed using Nektar++.
Moving reference frame formulation utilized for simulating three turbine geometries.
Focus on large-scale vortices and interactions during the dynamic stall process.
evidence_signal: DNS outcomes reveal that blade number significantly affects the breakdown of dynamic stall vortices and the transition to bluff-body dynamics.
watch_item: The findings may vary under different operational conditions not tested in this study.
paper_title: Direct Numerical Simulation of Vertical-Axis Wind Turbine Near-Wake Dynamics
